summary: @brick-v2/table exfiltrates CI/cloud credentials to oob.s4yhii.com on require()
details: The package ships a 470-byte index.js stub whose only behavior is to require('./prebuilds/linux-x64/metrics.node'). The bundled native ELF reads credential-grade environment variables (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN, ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN) together with host identity (gethostname, getpwuid, uname, getcwd) and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded endpoint oob.s4yhii.com/native. The native module calls fork+setsid to detach into a background process so the exfiltration survives the parent. The package name/scope and the implausible 999.0.1 version are consistent with a dependency-confusion lure targeting an internal @brick-v2 scope; installing or requiring this package automatically triggers the credential exfiltration.
